content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AAU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by AAU?
faq.answer: Anand Agricultural University (AAU) has announced a total of 4 vacancies for various posts including Junior Research Fellow, Project Assistant, and Contractual Staff (Research Fellow).

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for AAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person on the specified date and time.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the AAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, so there is no specific last date to apply. Candidates must attend the walk-in interview on 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: For the Junior Research Fellow post, candidates need to have an M. Tech / M.Sc. in Geoinformatics / Remote Sensing & GIS/Geomatics (Physics & Maths at 12th level) OR M.Sc. in Agriculture Analytics with 4/5 years of Bachelor's Degree.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for male and female candidates applying for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for male candidates is 35 years, and for female candidates, it is 40 years for all the announced posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary for Junior Research Fellow is Rs. 37,000/- + HRA per month for the 1st & 2nd year and Rs. 42,000/- + HRA per month for the 3rd year onwards as SRF, as per Gol norms.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Yagyavalkya Hall, Directorate of Research, Anand Agricultural University, Anand, Gujarat, 388110.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry their Bio-data, one passport-size photo, attested copies of documents (educational qualification, work experience, proof of age), and all original documents.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates are advised to report at 09:00 hrs on 21st August 2026 for the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any of the posts announced by Anand Agricultural University.
